The scene shifts to a grand hotel lobby featuring a minimalist indoor reflection pool and a high ceiling adorned with numerous hanging golden light spheres. (3) Inside an elevator with a mirrored, metallic finish, the main character takes a selfie holding a small handheld camera. She wears a beige sweatshirt and a long grey skirt. The video moves to a dimly lit hotel hallway with light wood-paneled walls and a grey carpet, leading to a room door. (4) The character enters a luxury hotel room, knocking on the door first. The bathroom is spacious, decorated with grey marble, two sinks, and a large white freestanding bathtub by a window with white blinds. At the Shinkuchan shopping district, rows of colorful hats, scarves, and bags are displayed on racks. A 7-Eleven store with pink Kanahei cartoon decorations on the ceiling and walls is showcased. (6) At Central Park, a market is in full swing with white tents. (7) As night falls, the character sits on a stone edge in the park, holding a cup of lemon jelly drink and a container of black octopus balls topped with bonito flakes. She eats and drinks while enjoying the atmosphere of the park's light tunnel and the large, glowing Christmas tree.
